mapper.insert: insert into orders (user_id, address_book_id, amount, delivery_status, estimated_delivery_time, pack_amount, pay_method, remark, tableware_number, tableware_status, number, order_time, status, pay_status, phone, address, user_name, consignee, checkout_time, delivery_time, cancel_reason, cancel_time,rejection_reason) values (#{userId}, #{addressBookId}, #{amount}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{estimatedDeliveryTime}, #{packAmount}, #{payMethod}, #{remark}, #{tablewareNumber}, #{tablewareStatus}, #{number}, #{orderTime}, #{status}, #{payStatus}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{userName}, #{consignee}, #{checkoutTime}, #{deliveryTime}, #{cancelReason}, #{cancelTime},#{rejectionReason})

insert into order_detail (order_id, dish_id, name, setmeal_id, dish_flavor, image, number, amount) values
(#{orderDetail.orderId}, #{orderDetail.dishId}, #{orderDetail.name},#{orderDetail.setmealId}, #{orderDetail.dishFlavor}, #{orderDetail.image}, #{orderDetail.number}, #{orderDetail.amount})

insert into shopping_cart (user_id, dish_id, name, setmeal_id, dish_flavor, image, number, amount, create_time) values
(#{cart.userId}, #{cart.dishId}, #{cart.name}, #{cart.setmealId}, #{cart.dishFlavor}, #{cart.image}, #{cart.number}, #{cart.amount}, #{cart.createTime})
mapper.update: update orders set status = #{status}, cancel_time = #{cancelTime}, pay_status = #{payStatus}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason} where id = #{id}
